title: Optimizing the discriminator to optimality in the inner loop is computationally prohibitive and causes overfitting
description: The minimax formulation ideally requires optimizing D to completion in each inner loop, but this is computationally infeasible and would overfit on finite datasets. In practice, only a few alternating updates are performed.
canonical_description: optimizing the discriminator to optimality in each inner loop is computationally prohibitive and causes overfitting on finite data

evidence.quote: Optimizing D to completion in the inner loop of training is computationally prohibitive, and on finite datasets would result in overfitting.
